steps.en: Unpaid court notices near the mention date are found
steps.id: Notice court yang belum dibayar dekat tanggal mention ditemukan
steps.why_en: Reminders are selected by notice stage, not by court mention date.
steps.why_id: Reminder dipilih berdasarkan stage notice, bukan tanggal court mention.

steps.en: Contact details are refreshed before sending
steps.why_en: The refresh exists but is not applied to court summons notices.
steps.why_id: Pembaruan kontak ada tetapi tidak diterapkan ke notice summons court.

steps.en: Reminders about upcoming court summonses are sent
steps.id: Reminder summons court yang mendekat dikirim
steps.why_en: Only reminders for other notice stages are sent, not court summons reminders.
steps.why_id: Hanya reminder untuk stage notice lain yang dikirim, bukan reminder summons court.
